notes.title: 🩸 Under The Floor – Patch Notes 0.2.75 🩸
notes.content: [p][b]Get ready to shiver… This update introduces new paranormal events, gameplay improvements, and numerous fixes to make the horror experience even more intense.[/b][/p][h3]🔔 New Features & Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Haunting statue[/b]: it now emits a sound whenever it moves—keep your eyes open and your ears sharper.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic footsteps[/b]: footstep sounds now change when the player walks on concrete for deeper immersion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Brighter atmosphere[/b]: overall brightness has been slightly increased while maintaining the oppressive mood.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Look further down[/b]: the player can now tilt the camera lower to inspect every dark corner.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Two new paranormal events[/b]: unexpected supernatural occurrences will keep you on edge.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚠️ Gameplay Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Unpredictable hunts[/b]: both the waiting time [i]and[/i] the duration of hunts are now randomized.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Limited interactions[/b]: equipment can no longer be used while interacting with an in-game object.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved flashlight[/b]: it now recharges faster during the day.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Ouija board[/b]: completely reworked to better understand the player’s questions.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🕯️ Additional Content[/h3][list][*][p]A [b]new warning message[/b] now informs players that sleeping will no longer be possible after a certain day…[/p][/*][*][p][b]New objective[/b]: complete a special task to obtain the [b]Whispering Key[/b], which unlocks the mysterious basement door.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Lamps during hunts[/b]: fixed an issue where some lamps remained on during a hunt.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exterior environment clipping[/b]: resolved a clipping issue in outdoor scenery.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ending scene audio[/b]: fixed a sound issue during the final scene.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Translation errors[/b]: several translation mistakes have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Death scene audio[/b]: fixed an audio bug in the death scene.[/p][/*][/list][p]…and many more secrets waiting to be discovered 👀[/p]
